word-landlord.def: a person who owns a house or apartment and lets others live in it for money

word-tenant.def: a person who pays money to live in a home owned by someone else

word-rent-n.def: the money you pay regularly to live in a home that belongs to someone else

word-deposit.def: money you pay at the start of a rental that the owner keeps until you leave

word-utilities.def: services such as electricity, water and gas that a home uses

word-utility-meter.def: a device that measures how much water, gas or electricity a home uses

word-real-estate-agent.def: a person whose job is to help people buy, sell or rent houses and apartments

word-studio-apartment.def: a small home with one main room that includes the sleeping and cooking areas

word-furnished.def: with tables, chairs, a bed and other things already inside

word-attic.def: a space under the roof of a house, often used for storing things

word-yard.def: the area of grass or ground around a house

word-mortgage.def: money borrowed from a bank to buy a home and paid back over many years

word-move-in.def: to begin living in a new home

word-move-out.def: to leave the home where you have been living

word-viewing.def: a visit to look at a home before you decide to rent or buy it

word-square-meter.def: a unit of area; a surface 100 centimeters long and 100 centimeters wide

word-bedroom.def: the room in a home where you sleep

word-living-room.def: the room in a home where people sit, talk and watch TV

word-dining-room.def: the room in a home where meals are eaten

word-intercom.def: a device by the door that lets you talk to a visitor before opening

word-floor-plan.def: a drawing that shows the rooms of a home from above

word-housing-n.def: places where people live, such as houses and apartments

word-key-money-jp.gl: reikin: nonrefundable gift paid to a landlord in Japan

word-jeonse-kr.gl: jeonse: large lump-sum deposit in Korea instead of monthly rent

word-communal-apartment-ru.gl: kommunalka: Russian apartment shared by several families

word-council-tax-uk.gl: council tax: UK local tax on homes, based on property value bands
